title: myroxylon coriaceum
intro: Myroxylon coriaceum, commonly known as Palo Santo, is a plant species native to South America, particularly in the tropical regions of Ecuador and Peru. It has been used for centuries in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Palo Santo are attributed to its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality, making it a popular natural remedy for stress-related disorders. The bioactive constituents of Palo Santo include limonene, beta-pinene, and alpha-pinene, which contribute to its medicinal properties and aroma.
